rules.why: The root vitest config has no @/ alias for admin/, so an admin test importing @/… fails to load in the Windows ci job.
rules.fix: Import with a relative path from admin/tests (../lib/…).

rules.why: A new bundled klypix-mcp src/*.mjs must be in the four app copy lists, or the deployed project brain cannot load it — and verify:mcp does not check this.
